risk_note: Payout read-only alert, RV2 by path (payout application, platform metrics, the fund alert rules), no money effect: no voucher, no balance change, no external write. The worker exports couli_payout_water_stale{app_id} (1 when an app has an Alipay withdrawal waiting in APPROVED and the latest Alipay W is missing or older than EXECUTE's two-hour limit, judged by the very judgeWatermark EXECUTE uses; BR-WDR-18 ②), read through payout's read-only port at scrape time and cached like the water-low gauge; a failed read fails the scrape, never a 0. couli-fund.yaml gets CouliPayoutWaterStale (for 5m, fund: 'true'), and the outdated W < 1.5P TODO is removed (that alert is B2-09j's CouliPayoutWaterLow). Rebased onto main 04fddbfc3: the conflicts in entry.ts and metrics/registry.ts were B3-08z's agent trace gauge next to this one, both kept. Three frozen spec files change as the ledger declares: [AC-B1-01zzi#6] allow list adds couli_payout_water_stale, [AC-B2-09j#24] regex narrowed to couli_payout_water_low (modify_existing tighten_only, D10-807), and the alerting-eval/metrics.test.ts registry fixture adds collectWaterStale outside the test bodies (red_exempt / red_exempt_outside; red-check expands its it.each(RULE_FILES) since CT-06zzzzi #2864).

reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh, effort medium, base the merge base 04fddbfc3, full review of the whole change with the citable-lines section (CT-06zzzzn); no findings (couli-runs/B2-09ze/money-review-r1.json).

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by fresh independent Claude contexts (claude-run.sh --phase test), four rounds: r1–r3 on 11-07, r4 on 11-09 under approvals 54 (only [AC-B2-09ze#24]). spec-test r1 / r2 by fresh independent Claude (r1 fail → round 2, r2 pass). r3 by Codex after the rebase (CT-06zzzzm #2909: Codex confirms independent Claude tests; D10-848 void): it covered the three frozen-file changes (allow list, water_low regex, the registry fixture with the two red_exempt [AC-B1-25b#8] entries and red_exempt_outside) without a finding on them, and failed on one S1, a test gap (an older APPROVED plus a newer non-APPROVED Alipay withdrawal of one app; the implementation already reads 'any APPROVED'). r4 by Codex, incremental, passed and closed it (spec-test-review-r3-codex.json, spec-test-review-r4-codex.json).
